assessments.reasoning: The SIST-distributed ISO/IEC document matches the publisher catalog’s title, sixth edition, date and committee. The raw hash matched. The cover and Clause 1 directly support the descriptive identification of SQL and its association with the ISO/IEC 9075 series.

challenge.method: I read the exact preview cover and Clause 1 and compared the document number, edition, committee attribution and scope against the ISO catalog. I checked for a subsequent correction and challenged the product interpretation. https://www.iso.org/standard/76583.html https://www.iso.org/standard/93690.html
challenge.results: The cover identifies SQL as a database language and Clause 1 places its grammar and processing specification across other parts of 9075. A database engine appears in the scope as an implementation of the language. ISO still describes that scope in its catalog and lists the separately published 2026 corrigendum.

limitations: Active records the catalog identity lifecycle. Source evidence establishes the language designation.

The controlling copy is the public sixth-edition June 2023 preview. The assessment concerns its original title and scope. The separately cataloged 2026 corrigendum and detailed standard clauses are outside the claim.
